# Harbor Homeware — Next Month PPC & SEO Execution Plan
**Prepared by:** Reporting Agent
**Reviewed by:** Workflow Supervisor Agent (approved), QA/Compliance Agent (pass)
**Period:** Next calendar month
**Status:** Approved for execution — subject to mandatory pre-launch gates
**Distribution:** Client stakeholders and internal delivery team

---

## Executive Summary

This plan covers PPC and SEO execution for Harbor Homeware across the coming month. Three commercial goals drive all activity: reduce wasted paid search spend, grow non-branded organic traffic, and improve monthly reporting quality.

**Month 1 is a foundation month.** No live performance data exists for this account. Every recommendation is grounded in structural signals from agency documents and the client profile. Optimisation decisions will begin in Month 2 once baselines are established.

Five pre-launch gates must be cleared before any live spend is activated or on-page changes are published. The Client Success Manager must chase all outstanding access items in Week 1. Until gates are cleared, PPC campaigns remain in draft/paused state.

---

## Pre-Launch Gates — Hard Stops

Nothing goes live until all applicable gates are resolved.

| # | Gate | Owner | Consequence if Skipped |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | Conversion tracking verified on all primary conversion actions | PPC Lead + Analytics Specialist | Live spend is unattributable; CPA optimisation impossible *(mw-agency-003)* |
| G2 | Primary conversion actions confirmed by client | Client Success Manager | Campaign goal and bidding strategy cannot be correctly configured *(mw-agency-002)* |
| G3 | Analytics access granted | Analytics Specialist | No performance baseline; reporting cannot meet policy requirements *(mw-agency-005)* |
| G4 | CMS access level confirmed | Client Success Manager | All SEO on-page fixes and content publishing remain theoretical *(mw-agency-015)* |
| G5 | Brand guidelines received | Client Success Manager | Ad copy and content briefs cannot be approved or finalised *(mw-agency-015)* |

> **Hard rule:** Zero live PPC spend until G1 and G2 are cleared. All campaigns remain in draft/paused state until that point. *(mw-agency-003)*

---

## Risk Register

| # | Risk | Severity | Owner | Current Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Conversion tracking unverified | Critical | PPC Lead + Analytics | Unresolved |
| R2 | Primary conversion actions not confirmed | Critical | Client Success Manager | Unresolved |
| R3 | CMS access level unclear | High | Client Success Manager | Unresolved |
| R4 | Product feed quality inconsistent | High | PPC Lead | Known issue — audit pending |
| R5 | Thin product page descriptions | High | SEO Lead + Content | Known issue — audit pending |
| R6 | No negative keyword lists in place | High | PPC Lead | To be built in Week 2 |
| R7 | Analytics access pending | High | Analytics Specialist | Unresolved |
| R8 | Brand guidelines not received | Medium | Client Success Manager | Unresolved |
| R9 | Limited historical SEO data | Medium | SEO Lead | Inherent — baseline to be set in Week 1 |
| R10 | Seasonal demand shifts strongly | Medium | PPC Lead + Content | To be factored into budget split and content timing |

*Sources: mw-agency-003, mw-agency-008, mw-agency-015*

---

**Campaign:** Harbor Homeware Paid Search Efficiency
**Monthly budget:** £12,500
**Goal:** Improve conversion efficiency — reduce wasted spend, tighten keyword intent, align landing pages to ad copy
